observation: Inspected the front, top and isometric views of this round; they are byte-identical to the renders inspected before the last source change, which touched only Saturn's ring. 152 x 152 x 9.00. Den d1, traps d2 and e1 and belt cells e4 and f4 are present as blind upward pockets, and the grid grooves run only between land cells. Probed at Z 8: air in every pocket, material on every land cell, material at Z 2 under each pocket floor. Flat underside, nothing missing, extra or intersecting.
